verdict.rationale: Independent compute benchmarking exists: a 60+ benchmark geo-mean found the RTX 5090 roughly matches the RTX 4080/4090 on performance-per-watt. Another report says its perf/W isn't better than those cards and can be significantly lower than the 4090 in some contexts. Reviewers also cite extreme power draw, a hot-running Founders Edition and draw exceeding 600 W, so efficiency for sustained workloads is not demonstrated. Missing for 10: a first-party documented power envelope (TDP/TGP, power limits), evidence of better-than-predecessor perf/W, and sustained-ML-workload efficiency testing.
